title: Predicting EGFR mutation, ALK rearrangement, and uncommon EGFR mutation in NSCLC patients by driverless artificial intelligence: a cohort study
summary: A stacked ensemble of one deep-learning and five machine-learning models, trained on 1,089 retrospective cases and tested on 1,464 consecutive cases, predicted EGFR and ALK status against a molecular reference, with test AUCs of 0.883 for EGFR and 0.921 for ALK and 0.83 accuracy for distinguishing common from uncommon EGFR mutations. The single-center design and the reported test accuracy limit generalization.
